title: Research Grant / Funding Proposal
purpose: Request resources for a defined programme of work. It may be submitted before a paper exists; planned work and preliminary evidence must be labelled accurately.

sections.title: Call Fit and Submission Compliance
sections.instruction: Capture funder, call ID, version/date, deadline/timezone, eligible applicant/geography, award range, duration, cost-share, indirect-cost rules, page limits, attachments, evaluation criteria and submission portal. The live call overrides this generic template.

sections.title: Cover Sheet and Administrative Data
sections.instruction: Applicant, lead PI, co-investigators, partners, legal entity, addresses, project title, duration, requested amount, keywords, declarations and authorized signatories.

sections.title: Project Summary / Abstract
sections.instruction: Concise overview of problem, objective, approach, expected outputs, significance and beneficiaries. Follow call-specific structure and word limit.

sections.title: Problem: Context and Need
sections.instruction: Define the problem, affected stakeholders, scale, geography, evidence base and why the timing matters. Cite reliable sources.

sections.title: Knowledge / Technology Gap and State of the Art
sections.instruction: Compare existing approaches and explain precisely what remains unresolved. Do not claim novelty without a documented prior-art/literature review.

sections.title: Objectives: Research Questions and Hypotheses
sections.instruction: Make objectives measurable, bounded and linked to outcomes. Hypotheses are optional where inappropriate; do not force them into engineering development calls.

sections.title: Innovation and Contribution
sections.instruction: Explain technical, methodological, scientific, societal or implementation novelty and distinguish proposed novelty from demonstrated advantage.

sections.title: Approach: Methodology and Work Packages
sections.instruction: Describe methods, work packages, tasks, dependencies, milestones, deliverables, acceptance criteria, owners and decision gates.

sections.title: System Architecture / Technical Plan
sections.instruction: Use canonical SIR, architecture graph, interfaces, component choices, alternatives, verification strategy and lifecycle plan.

sections.title: Preliminary Work and Evidence
sections.instruction: Present prior work, prototypes, simulation, datasets and tests with fidelity labels. If none, state no preliminary results and explain feasibility through analysis or staged risk reduction.

sections.title: Expected Outcomes: Impact and Dissemination
sections.instruction: Separate outputs, outcomes and longer-term impacts. Define indicators, beneficiaries, dissemination, adoption and attribution.

sections.title: Team: Governance and Partnerships
sections.instruction: Roles, qualifications, time commitments, partner contributions, decision rights, facilities and capability gaps. Verify all biographies and commitments.

sections.title: Facilities: Equipment and Resources
sections.instruction: Inventory available and requested facilities, instruments, compute, labs, software, manufacturing capability and access arrangements.

sections.title: Timeline and Milestones
sections.instruction: Map tasks and dependencies to a calendar. Include review gates, procurement lead times, approvals and contingency.

sections.title: Risk: Safety: Ethics and Compliance
sections.instruction: Risk register with likelihood, consequence, mitigation, residual risk, owner, safety, privacy, cybersecurity, environmental, export and regulatory issues.

sections.title: Budget and Justification
sections.instruction: Build from BOM, labor, travel, facilities, equipment, consumables, services, subawards, overhead and contingency. State currency, tax, rates, quotes, assumptions and call allowability.

sections.title: Sustainability and Continuation
sections.instruction: Explain post-award operations, maintenance, ownership, data/software stewardship, recurring costs and continuation or exit.

sections.title: Data: Software and Research Output Management
sections.instruction: Data types, standards, metadata, storage, access, retention, sharing, licensing, privacy, security, software and reproducibility.

sections.title: Intellectual Property and Knowledge Transfer
sections.instruction: Background/foreground IP, ownership, licensing, publication review, patent timing, partner agreements and transfer route.

sections.title: References
sections.instruction: Verified sources only, formatted to call rules.

sections.title: Required Annexes
sections.instruction: CVs, letters, ethics approvals, partner commitments, detailed budget, Gantt, facilities, data plan, risk matrix and call-specific forms.
